_about: Regions for packages/testbed/src/lighting.html at ?frame=body&bare, 900x1200. G2 is deliberately ABSENT: the eye is about 8 px across at full-body framing and any sclera patch would be more lash and lid than sclera, so measure.mjs is left to SKIP it rather than be handed a number nobody should believe.

faceKey.note: G1. Key-side cheek. 14x13 px = 182 pixels, which is what a face IS at this framing; read the ratio with that sample size in mind.

flatCheek.note: G4. Not a cheek at this framing — a 40x40 patch of flat chest, because the cheek is 20 px wide and G4 needs 16x16. Named for the gate, not the anatomy.

shadowTerminator.note: G3. Shadow-side torso, on the turn.
